e1.title: Health & welfare counseling
e1.desc: Emergency welfare and medical cost support
e1.tip: For urgent rescue or medical emergencies, call 119 first. Ask about eligibility and application steps.

e2.title: Fire, rescue & ambulance
e2.desc: Request emergency fire, rescue, or medical response
e2.tip: From a safe place, give your location, situation, and the number of people needing help.

e3.title: Police emergency
e3.desc: Report crimes or threats and request police response
e3.tip: Give your location and situation. You can report by text if speaking is difficult.

e4.title: KDCA 1339 call center
e4.tip: Ask about infectious diseases, prevention, vaccination, and reporting procedures.

e5.title: Prosecution crime victim support
e5.tip: For urgent crimes or threats to your safety, call 112 first.

e6.title: Consular Safety Call Center
e6.desc: Help with overseas incidents and emergencies
e6.tip: Ask the counselor about emergency interpretation and local response options.

e7.title: Suicide prevention counseling
e7.tip: If someone's life or physical safety is in immediate danger, call 119 or 112 first.

e8.title: NIS national security reporting
e8.desc: Report espionage, terrorism, or industrial spying
e8.tip: Calls to 111 without an area code are free. Text #0111 and official online reporting are also available.

e9.title: Police counter-espionage reporting
e9.desc: Report espionage, technology leaks, or terrorism
e9.tip: For urgent crimes or threats to your safety, call 112.

e10.title: Military resident reporting
e10.tip: Report suspicious military-related situations. For urgent crimes or rescue, call 112 or 119.

e14.title: Environmental pollution reporting
e14.tip: Prepare the location, time, and type of pollution. From a mobile phone, dial the area code followed by 128.

e15.title: Unsafe food reporting
e15.desc: Report substandard food or labeling violations
e15.tip: Use the relevant dedicated channels for medicines, narcotics, medical devices, or cosmetics.

c1.title: Expressway emergency towing
c1.desc: Guidance on moving disabled vehicles to safety
c1.tip: Move to safety first, then give the road location and vehicle situation. Confirm eligibility and towing limits.

c3.title: Traffic accident emergency report
c3.desc: Request police response to an accident
c3.tip: Give the accident location and current dangers. Check separate police procedures for accident certificates and routine inquiries.

c4.title: Traffic accident rescue & ambulance
c4.tip: Give the location, injuries, and number of people. Follow first-aid instructions.

c6.title: Hit-and-run & uninsured crash support
c6.tip: Ask about eligibility and required documents. Not all accidents or property damage qualify.

c7.title: Transport administration guidance
c7.desc: Find the appropriate transport or licensing office
c7.tip: Free phone counseling is available 24 hours every day. Request emergency response through 112 or 119.

c8.title: Police lost property inquiries
c8.tip: Report or search on LOST112, or call 182. Also check the transport operator's own lost property center.

c9.title: KORAIL customer center
c9.tip: Check KORAIL's guidance or the phone menu for hours, lost property, and refund procedures.

h1.title: Postal forwarding after moving
h1.tip: Check forwarding conditions, duration, and fees. Update bank, card, and insurance addresses separately.

h2.title: Neighbor noise counseling
h2.desc: Apartment noise counseling and on-site support
h2.tip: Binding mediation or resolution is not guaranteed. Ask about eligibility and procedures.

h3.title: HUG rental deposit guarantees
h3.tip: Check guarantee eligibility and coverage. Rental fraud victim support uses a separate channel.

h5.title: KEPCO power faults & outages
h5.tip: For urgent hazards such as fire or electric shock, call 119 first.

h6.title: K-water customer center
h6.tip: If K-water does not serve your area, contact the local water authority. Ask 110 if you do not know the responsible office.

h7.title: Weather counseling
h7.tip: Ask about typhoons, heavy rain, heat waves, cold spells, and other weather alerts.

l1.title: Legal counseling
l1.desc: Legal advice and legal aid eligibility

l3.title: Financial consumer counseling
l3.desc: Financial products and illegal finance harm
l3.tip: For financial products or illegal finance, call 1332. For phishing counseling and tips, call 1394. For urgent crime, call 112.

l4.title: Voice phishing & smishing reports
l4.tip: End a suspected phishing call, then contact 1394 for advice or reporting. For immediate crime or threats, call 112.

l5.title: Personal data infringement
l5.desc: Data leaks and privacy infringement advice
l5.tip: Prepare information and evidence about the data leak or infringement.

l9.title: Hacking & internet security
l9.tip: 118 advises on internet security incidents. For urgent crime, call 112; for integrated phishing reports, call 1394.

d2.title: Mobile carrier customer service
d2.desc: Your carrier's billing and service inquiries
d2.tip: Dial 114 without an area code from your subscribed mobile phone. For a budget carrier, check that provider's guidance.

d3.title: Broadcast & communications review
d3.desc: Harmful or illegal content review guidance

d4.title: Illegal spam reports
d4.tip: For spam, call 118; for phishing advice and reports, call 1394. For immediate crime, call 112.

l7.title: National tax counseling
l7.desc: Income tax, VAT, and national tax inquiries

l11.title: Consumer counseling
l11.tip: Prepare contracts, transaction records, and other relevant documents.

f1.title: Older adult care support
f1.desc: National older adult care support inquiries

f2.title: School violence reporting
f2.tip: Call 117 or text #0117. For immediate danger, call 112.

f3.title: Women's emergency hotline
f3.tip: If your safety is in immediate danger, call 112.

f5.title: Immigration Contact Center
f5.desc: Multilingual visa, residency, and immigration advice

f6.title: Youth counseling
f6.desc: Support for young people and guardians

f8.title: Older adult abuse reporting
f8.desc: Report abuse or neglect and ask about protection
f8.tip: Seek counseling if abuse or neglect is suspected. For immediate danger, call 112.

w1.title: Employment & labor counseling
w1.desc: Benefits, labor standards, and employment support

g4.title: Gyeonggi Call Center
g4.desc: Gyeonggi provincial and daily life inquiries

g12.title: Gangwon Call Center
g12.desc: Gangwon provincial and daily life inquiries

g18.title: Gyeongsangnam-do 120 Call Center
g18.desc: Gyeongnam provincial and daily life inquiries

org-bank-kb-incident.tip: After connecting, press * and choose the report menu for the lost item.

org-bank-woori-incident.desc: Lost items and financial fraud reports
org-bank-woori-incident.tip: IVR #-1: voice phishing; #-2-3: passbook or seal loss; #-2-5: security card or OTP loss.
